integrity: The all-positive-integer assertion follows from an explicit partition decomposition and two-box deletion proof; independent finite exact enumeration tests 16 small parameter pairs but does not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Topological compactly supported Euler characteristics of two-step punctual ideal incidences over C, not motives, Betti numbers, intermediate flags, or incidence-scheme singularity classifications. Historical priority remains provisional; the full text of Lee (2009) was not accessible for a decisive stronger-coverage comparison.
title: Two-step nested punctual Hilbert schemes of every fat node: a rational Euler series
